protocol.instances: All five methods share each full region instance; same ensemble and set seed as experiment_equal_cost.py.
protocol.random_order: Uniform permutation drawn once per instance from an independent recorded seed; shared by random-order naive and SS. Timing uses a separate RNG stream so calibration cannot change the selected order.
protocol.optimized_order: Subset DP minimizes naive AA's finite cost; both optimized-order variants share that order. SS does not independently optimize its order or merge tests.
protocol.success: Unit Boolean-query costs; common target success. RGS uses its theorem certificate, not an empirical probability; both SS variants use final coherent amplify.
protocol.timing: Random variants include shared random-draw time plus their own planning/optimization. Optimized naive is the DP stage, optimized SS adds its own SS optimization to the same measured DP stage. Totals are sums of component medians, not independently measured end-to-end samples.
protocol.excluded: Imports, RNG initialization, warmup, set generation, full-table conversion/validation, cardinality acquisition, quantum simulation, I/O, statistics and plotting. Only the optimized variants are charged subset DP.
protocol.statistics: Means with paired-index 95% bootstrap intervals; incomplete five-method groups are omitted from figures; failed cases stop the run without replacement.
